gen-gf-sniglet-gf-electrolize: Sniglet keeps its terminals short of curling back, level and quiet. Electrolize, plain sans with a pliers-like open jaw on the c, keeps paragraphs crisp and modern down the page.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-exo-2: Spaghetti-like lines wander through every Sniglet letter, with no accents of weight. Exo 2 then settles into plain sans curves with daylight inside them, so extended reading feels clean and unhurried.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-faculty-glyphic: Flat, unvarying strokes with a commanding streak: Sniglet is hard to mistake for anything else. And Faculty Glyphic brings modern, plain sans letters whose rounded forms keep clear openings.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-fahkwang: Fahkwang reads soft and approachable, with curves that finish before they close. Sniglet holds a steady weight up top while the sans below swells faintly in its widest bowls.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-fustat: Terminals that stop short of curling back give Sniglet its signature. Fustat, a sans-serif drawn like bent tubing, keeps a wide gap where the c ends, so paragraphs move along easily.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-gantari: Approachable and wire-bent, Gantari draws wide, open curves throughout. Sniglet is best at making a quiet, level statement while the sans-serif body is best at carrying the words along.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-gayathri: Marker-nib strokes that ignore direction give Sniglet a loose, level swagger. Gayathri, plain sans with the gentle stroke shift of a letterpress slug, gives paragraphs a soft texture where light strokes barely recede.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-google-sans: Google Sans draws every curve and downstroke with matching weight. What stands out most is how Sniglet and this sans-serif both stay quietly level, one commanding and one approachable.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-google-sans-flex: Terminals that halt before curling back make Sniglet level, quiet and commanding. And Google Sans Flex, sans-serif with ribbon-cut stroke ends, matches that restraint with clean, open curve endings.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-gotu: Sniglet draws like a technical pen, steady and quietly commanding. Gotu, plain sans with moderate stroke contrast and open-mouthed e crossbars, keeps paragraphs tidy and modern line after line.
